name: Google Analytics
description: Query Google Analytics accounts, properties, and run core, realtime, and funnel reports through the Google Analytics MCP server.

inputs.label: Google Application Default Credentials (ADC) Path
inputs.description: Path to your application_default_credentials.json (generated via gcloud) or a Service Account JSON key file.

obtain.instructions:
1. Create an OAuth 2.0 Client ID (Desktop app) in Google Cloud Console and download the JSON.
2. Run: gcloud auth application-default login --scopes=https://www.googleapis.com/auth/analytics.readonly,https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform --client-id-file=PATH_TO_CLIENT_JSON
3. Provide the generated path (%APPDATA%\gcloud\application_default_credentials.json on Windows, or ~/.config/gcloud/application_default_credentials.json on macOS/Linux).

inputs.label: Google Cloud Project ID
inputs.description: The Google Cloud Project ID where Google Analytics Admin and Data APIs are enabled.

auth.instructions: Requires Google Cloud Application Default Credentials (ADC). Enable the Google Analytics Admin & Data APIs in your Google Cloud Project, create a Desktop OAuth Client ID, and run 'gcloud auth application-default login' with the analytics.readonly scope.
